about_the_game:
Cat of Egypt is a cinematic, story-driven 2D adventure set during the biblical plagues of Egypt.

You play as Pharaoh’s cat — loyal, curious, and suddenly caught in a world unraveling as water turns to blood and frogs overrun the palace. Guided by ancient hieroglyphs and echoes of divine power, you must uncover the truth behind Pharaoh’s curse and the meaning of “I Am Who I Am.”

Explore a hand-drawn Egyptian world filled with symbolism, hidden passages, and quiet moments of reflection beneath the palace walls. Each plague unfolds as a chapter of discovery, danger, and redemption, blending exploration, environmental puzzles, and cinematic encounters.

Features

  • Symbolic Exploration – Decode hieroglyphs, uncover hidden meanings, and unlock paths woven into the world itself.

  • Cinematic 2D Adventure – Hand-drawn environments with smooth transitions and carefully paced storytelling.

  • Meaningful Encounters – Face each plague’s guardian through creative boss encounters that combine timing, observation, and problem-solving.

  • Unique Movement Mechanics – Master rope swinging, pole climbing, and paw climbing to navigate ancient spaces.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling – Encounter a mysterious talking frog who guides and challenges you throughout your journey.

  • Art & Music – A moody visual style inspired by Neversong and Neva, paired with an original, emotional soundtrack.

Current Version

The current release includes the first chapter, “The Frog Plague,” featuring:

  • 11 playable frames (scenes)

  • 1 complete boss encounter

  • Environmental puzzles and hidden secrets

  • Full controller and keyboard support

Future updates will expand the story through the remaining plagues, culminating in the final revelation of Pharaoh’s cat’s journey.
